title: ROOM SWITCH — A compact rental room for work, meals and rest, 6 deliverables

# ROOM SWITCH

## Occupancy and scope
- Occupants: 1
- Daily uses: laptop work, dining for 1, sleeping for 1
- Retained elements: room shell, door, window, radiator, service shaft, outlets, switch, curtain rod, floor, ceiling light, F-01 to F-04
- Movable elements: F-01 to F-04
- Additions: 1 freestanding storage unit, curtains, table-clamp light, bed-clipped light
- Printed project name: ROOM SWITCH
- Printed plan labels: Work / Dine; Rest

## Room geometry
| Element | Position and dimensions |
|---|---|
| Coordinate system | Southwest internal corner at (0, 0, 0); x east, y north, z upwards; coordinates in m |
| Internal envelope | x = 0–3.6; y = 0–4.8; z = 0–2.6 |
| D-01 doorway | South wall; x = 0.2–1.0; z = 0–2.1; width 0.8 m |
| D-01 leaf | West jamb hinge at (0.2, 0); 0.8 m leaf; inward 90-degree swing; open endpoint (0.2, 0.8) |
| W-01 window | North wall; x = 1.2–2.8; z = 0.9–2.1; sliding sash |
| R-01 radiator | x = 1.4–2.6; y = 4.65–4.8; z = 0.15–0.75 |
| SH-01 service shaft | x = 3.3–3.6; y = 4.5–4.8; z = 0–2.6 |
| E-01 outlet | West wall; y = 2.4; z = 0.3 |
| E-02 outlet | East wall; y = 2.6; z = 0.3 |
| S-01 ceiling-light switch | South wall; x = 1.1; z = 1.1 |
| Curtain rod | North wall; x = 1.0–3.0; y = 4.6; z = 2.25 |
| L-01 ceiling light | Centre at (1.8, 2.4, 2.6) |

## Retained furniture
| ID | Piece | Overall dimensions in mm | Appearance |
|---|---|---|---|
| F-01 | Single bed, frame and mattress | 2000 length × 1000 width × 650 maximum height | Honey-coloured pine frame; five vertical headboard slats; off-white mattress; mattress top at 450 mm |
| F-02 | Table | 1100 width × 600 depth × 740 height | White rectangular top; four straight round white legs |
| F-03 | Chair | 450 width × 500 depth × 800 height | Natural beech frame; muted green upholstered seat; curved beech back; seat height 450 mm |
| F-04 | Wardrobe | 800 width × 550 depth × 1900 height | Cream carcass; two sliding doors; recessed vertical pulls |

## Storage and circulation
| Item | Quantity or dimension |
|---|---|
| Additional storage | 1 freestanding unit; maximum 900 width × 350 depth × 1400 height mm |
| Laptop | 1; 350 × 250 × 25 mm closed |
| Storage boxes | 2; each 300 × 240 × 180 mm |
| Continuous circulation | Minimum clear width 750 mm; entrance to bed, table and wardrobe |
| Turning circle | Clear diameter 900 mm |
| Wardrobe access | Clear depth 600 mm across its front |
| Radiator clearance | Clear depth 300 mm in front of its room-facing surface |
| Door opening | Full 90-degree inward swing |

## Materials and lighting
| Code | Material or fixture | Position and finish or control |
|---|---|---|
| FL-01 | Existing oak-effect laminate | Room floor; medium oak tone |
| WL-01 | Existing painted plaster | Walls; warm white |
| WD-01 | Birch plywood with clear finish | Additional storage unit |
| TX-01 | Oatmeal linen curtains | Existing north-wall rod |
| AC-01 | Warm grey wool felt, 12 mm thick | Exposed backing on the additional storage unit; backing footprint within the unit's overall dimensions |
| L-01 | Existing surface-mounted opal ceiling light, 3000 K | (1.8, 2.4, 2.6) m; ambient light; S-01 wall switch |
| L-02 | Plug-in table-clamp task light, 3000 K | F-02 tabletop edge; integral switch |
| L-03 | Plug-in bed-clipped reading light, 2700 K | F-01 headboard; integral switch |

## Perspective records
| View | Camera in m | Target in m | State |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 work | (0.9, 1.2, 1.5) | (2.7, 3.5, 1.0) | 1 seated tenant; laptop on F-02; L-02 on |
| C1 dining | (0.9, 1.2, 1.5) | (2.7, 3.5, 1.0) | 1 seated tenant; 1 place setting on F-02; laptop in additional storage |
| C2 rest | (2.9, 3.9, 1.5) | (0.8, 2.0, 0.8) | 1 tenant reading in F-01; L-03 on |

# ROOM SWITCH — delivery catalog

This table lists every commissioned deliverable with its tier, file format and stage. What each deliverable must contain is stated in the commission letter.

| # | id | Deliverable | Tiers | Format and stage |

| 1 | furniture-plan | Dimensioned furniture plan | 6 | Format: PNG, 1600 by 2400 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 2 | east-elevation | East-facing internal elevation | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 3 | storage-detail | Storage construction and capacity detail | 6 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 4 | work-perspective | C1 work-state perspective | 6 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 5 | dining-perspective | C1 dining-state perspective | 6 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | rest-perspective | C2 evening rest perspective | 6 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |

steps.userMessage:
ROOM SWITCH | A compact rental room for work, meals and rest

Our rental room serves one person who works at home, eats at the same table and sleeps here. The internal envelope is 3.6 m east–west by 4.8 m north–south, with a 2.6 m ceiling. Coordinates start at the southwest internal corner: x runs east, y north and z upwards. The south doorway runs from x = 0.2 to 1.0 m, is 2.1 m high and has an inward-opening leaf hinged at its west jamb. The north window runs from x = 1.2 to 2.8 m, with a 0.9 m sill and a 1.2 m opening height. The radiator below it projects 0.15 m into the room; a 0.3 × 0.3 m full-height service shaft occupies the northeast corner. Retain the shell, openings, services, floor and ceiling light in their recorded positions. New additions are freestanding storage, textiles and plug-in lighting.

The retained furniture is one pine bed, 2000 × 1000 × 650 mm; one white table, 1100 × 600 × 740 mm; one beech chair with a green seat, 450 × 500 × 800 mm; and one cream sliding-door wardrobe, 800 × 550 × 1900 mm. These are overall length or width × depth × height dimensions, including the bed frame. Their positions can change. Add one storage unit, at most 900 × 350 × 1400 mm, to hold a 350 × 250 × 25 mm laptop and two 300 × 240 × 180 mm boxes. Use clear-finished birch plywood WD-01 for this unit, oatmeal linen TX-01 at the existing curtain rod and a wool-felt backing AC-01 on the storage unit. Retain ceiling light L-01 and add a table-clamp task light L-02 and a bed-clipped reading light L-03, each with its own switch. Print "ROOM SWITCH" on the drawings and "Work / Dine" and "Rest" on the furniture plan.

Audience: the tenant and a local furniture maker, for choosing the arrangement and building the additional storage.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md records the room, furniture, finishes, lighting and camera coordinates. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the six deliverables and their proportions, formats and stages. room-survey.png provides the fixed plan and north and east elevations. retained-furniture.png records the appearance and dimensions of the four retained pieces. work-at-table.png provides atmosphere for laptop work at the existing table. meal-at-table.png provides atmosphere for the same tenant eating at that table.

Deliverables:
1. One dimensioned furniture plan locating all four retained pieces, the additional storage, lighting, camera positions, the door swing, the narrowest circulation width and a clear turning circle
2. One east-facing internal elevation with furniture outlines, storage, material and lighting codes, and heights above the floor
3. One storage detail sheet with front and side views, overall and compartment dimensions, laptop and box positions, the WD-01 construction and AC-01 backing
4. One work-state perspective from C1 at (0.9, 1.2, 1.5) m towards (2.7, 3.5, 1.0) m, showing the laptop on the table and task light in use
5. One dining-state perspective from the same C1 position and target, showing one place setting and the laptop in storage
6. One evening rest perspective from C2 at (2.9, 3.9, 1.5) m towards (0.8, 2.0, 0.8) m, showing the bed and reading light in use

Acceptance:
- Preserve the 3.6 × 4.8 × 2.6 m envelope and the recorded door, window, radiator and shaft geometry in the furniture plan, east-facing elevation and all three perspectives; use the stated C1 and C2 viewpoints for the perspectives.
- Dimension a continuous route at least 750 mm wide from the entrance to the bed, table and wardrobe, a clear 900 mm turning circle, the full 90-degree door swing, 600 mm clear in front of the wardrobe and 300 mm clear in front of the radiator on the furniture plan; retain those spaces in all three perspectives.
- Identify F-01 through F-04 on the furniture plan and preserve their recorded dimensions and recognisable finishes in the elevation and perspectives wherever visible; use one fixed furniture arrangement across the work, dining and rest views.
- Dimension the single storage unit within 900 × 350 × 1400 mm on the storage detail sheet and elevation, with compartments accommodating the laptop and both boxes at their stated sizes; show the laptop moving from the table in the work perspective to this unit in the dining perspective.
- Locate WD-01, TX-01, AC-01 and L-01 through L-03 on the furniture plan and elevation, repeat WD-01 and AC-01 on the storage detail sheet, and provide a readable material and lighting key on the dining perspective; show the three light types and their individual controls in the elevation.
- Print ROOM SWITCH on the furniture plan, elevation and storage detail sheet, and print Work / Dine and Rest on the furniture plan; show one laptop workstation, one dining place setting and one occupied bed respectively in the three named perspectives.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
